title: Serena Williams: Tennis Dominance
description: The most successful tennis player in the Open Era, with 23 Grand Slam singles titles and cultural impact beyond sports
imageHint: 🎾 The GOAT of tennis with unmatched power and determination 🏆

questions.question: How many Grand Slam singles titles did Serena Williams win during her career?
questions.hint: One more than Steffi Graf's previous record, the most in the Open Era

questions.question: Serena won her first Grand Slam at age 17. Which tournament was it?
questions.hint: Her home country's major tournament, held in New York

questions.question: What is the name of Serena's older sister, also a tennis champion and frequent doubles partner?
questions.hint: Named after a planet (and Roman goddess), she paved the way for Serena's success

questions.question: Serena won the 2017 Australian Open while pregnant. How many months pregnant was she?
questions.hint: Early in her pregnancy, she was already expecting her daughter Olympia

questions.question: What phrase did Serena make famous when challenging line calls and bad officiating?
questions.hint: A questioning phrase expressing disbelief at unfair treatment

deeperMode.title: Queen of the Court
deeperMode.description: Serena's battles beyond tennis and her impact on sports culture

questions.question: Serena revolutionized tennis fashion. What type of outfit did she wear that was initially banned by the French Open?
questions.hint: A form-fitting black outfit that helped with blood circulation but was deemed too bold

questions.question: What life-threatening condition did Serena experience after giving birth to her daughter Olympia?
questions.hint: Dangerous blood clots in the lungs that required emergency surgery
